courses.overview: 從偵測、遏止與業務復原的協調延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend coordination of detection, containment and business recovery to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 軟體弱點管理流程
related.why: 共同使用資產盤點與版本證據
related.whyEn: Both use asset inventories and version evidence
related.transfer: 共同使用資產盤點與版本證據
related.transferEn: Both use asset inventories and version evidence
related.difference: 應變需在不完整資訊下決策
related.differenceEn: Response must decide with incomplete information

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「軟體弱點管理流程」共用的資料／元件介面；以「共同使用資產盤點與版本證據」指出能保留的條件。
針對「應變需在不完整資訊下決策」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with software vulnerability-management workflows; use "Both use asset inventories and version evidence" to identify retained conditions.
For "Response must decide with incomplete information", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 數位鑑識證據保全
related.why: 事件分析仰賴證據保全
related.whyEn: Response analysis relies on preserved evidence
related.transfer: 事件分析仰賴證據保全
related.transferEn: Response analysis relies on preserved evidence
related.difference: 證據保全重視不可改寫而非快速恢復服務
related.differenceEn: Preservation prioritizes nonalteration rather than rapid service restoration
